_comment: NRG standards the tool must not invent. EVERY LIST SHIPS EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Until a list is approved, the control that depends on it verifies the components it can and reports the approved-list component as not assessed (never as a pass). Fill in only approved values.

DmarcReportingAddresses._help: Addresses or @domains that must appear in every managed domain's DMARC rua (for example the DMARCian address). DNS-1.3.

CommonAttachmentFileTypes._help: File extensions (no dot, lower-case) that must be in the malware policy's blocked common-attachment list. DEF-2.3.

PriorityUsers._help: User addresses that must be in TargetedUsersToProtect of the anti-phishing policy in force. EXO-1.5.

RequiredConditionalAccessTemplates._help: Ids from Config/conditional-access-baseline.json that NRG requires Enforced (for example block-legacy-auth, mfa-all-users). AAD-2.1.

DistributionListMaxMembers._help: One whole number: the most direct members NRG allows on a distribution list (for example "500"). DL-2.1, distribution-list worksheet only. Empty means not approved: the member count is reported and not assessed.

DistributionListAllowedJoinRestrictions._help: MemberJoinRestriction values NRG accepts on a distribution list, most preferred first: any of Open, Closed, ApprovalRequired. DL-1.4, distribution-list worksheet only. Empty means not approved: the setting is reported and not assessed.

DistributionListAllowedDepartRestriction._help: MemberDepartRestriction values NRG accepts on a distribution list, most preferred first: any of Open, Closed. DL-1.5, distribution-list worksheet only. Empty means not approved: the setting is reported and not assessed.

DistributionListExternalMembers._help: Set to exactly one value, Prohibited, to make external members (addresses outside the tenant's accepted domains) a shortfall. DL-2.2, distribution-list worksheet only. Empty means not approved: external members are listed and not assessed.
